review.reviewer: same-family provisional implementation and assumption review
review.scope: Tracked diff plus untracked repair implementation, runner, tests, SPEC, ASSUMPTIONS, and BUILD_NOTE; read-only review except this report.

undeclared.decision: Choose the first arm by the parent experiment ID's final hexadecimal digit parity.
undeclared.why_it_matters: Execution order is a research-protocol choice not determined by the request. It was disclosed in docs and retry metadata but absent from the assumption ledger; it is neither randomization nor guaranteed balance.

undeclared.decision: For a local-default parent, reuse the current local configuration route rather than pin a historically resolved model and effort.
undeclared.why_it_matters: A-002 originally claimed exact model/effort inheritance, but local-default archives retain aliases and the CLI resolves current configuration. Historical model/effort equality is not established for this route.

stale_rows.issue: The original exact model/effort inheritance statement overstates what can be established for local-default parents.
stale_rows.disposition: Qualify current-config inheritance separately from explicit overrides.

material_issues.issue: Normal local-default parents cannot prepare a repair pair because their effort='local-default' is forwarded into prepare(), which rejects it before local configuration fields are restored.
material_issues.evidence: Reproduced against the synthetic calibrated failed parent using local_codex=True, model='local-default', effort='local-default', and config_source='local_codex_config'; prepare_repair raised EvidenceError('Invalid effort or sandbox mode').
material_issues.disposition: Parent fixed the temporary preparation effort, restored the archived effort before returning, and added a local-default command regression test.

second_sweep_evidence: Re-read revised repair.py and ASSUMPTIONS.md: A-011 declares deterministic parity ordering and its limitations; A-002 distinguishes explicit overrides from current local-default configuration.
Ran python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_hypothesis_repair.py after the fix: 7 tests passed.

Ran a direct regression_summary check with one required and one forbidden gain, plus one required and one forbidden loss: all four were accounted for separately and the candidate remained ineligible despite equal gains.
source_job selects the latest evaluated candidate copy, verifies its inventory, requires a calibrated semantic failure, and does not copy the mutable job workspace.

Prompt construction gives both arms the same task/current D and continuation instruction; only the hypothesis arm receives failed check identifiers, polarities, hypotheses and source context. Hidden oracle payloads and parent answer are not serialized into these prompts.

Hypotheses are candidates or unclassified/insufficient-evidence records with proposed order and falsification procedures. State and call evidence are qualified as lexical/syntactic; no verified cause or complete dataflow claim is made.
Required and forbidden checks are converted to passing obligations with explicit booleans; oracle/case/runtime mismatches or invalid effect fields prevent verified per-job regression eligibility.
The prior matrix export contains 11 failed review rows. Live follow-up is still pending at review time, and this review makes no empirical benefit claim.
review.qualification: Same-family provisional review; clean means no remaining material implementation or ledger gaps found in the inspected scope, not proof of causal validity or live experimental benefit.
